milestones.notes: All 7 M1 fixtures + parse-partition + paren-separator + @verify tests pass. Two extra printer fixes made scoring.ail + per_function_depth_verify.ail formattable too, taking preExistingRT from 28 to 0 (vs the doc's 28-file target — MORE coverage).
